questions.prompt: An event needs 10 units. Only 8 are available to reserve after existing commitments. What should Marketing do?

options.label: Reserve 10 using the total on-hand quantity
Reserve no more than 8 and coordinate the remaining demand with Warehouse
Split the same product across lines to reserve all 10

questions.explanation: Reservations must fit uncommitted available stock. Quantities for the same product are combined across lines; splitting lines does not increase availability.

questions.prompt: Marketing successfully reserves stock for an event. What has this action established?

options.label: An event stock commitment; authorized Warehouse staff must still issue the items
The stock has been physically issued to the event
Any quality hold on the stock has been released

questions.explanation: A reservation commits stock but is not a physical issue or quality release. Warehouse retains the governed custody and issue workflow.

questions.prompt: What must be checked on an event reservation before submission?

options.label: Only the total quantity across all products
Any available event, with all items marked as giveaways
The correct event, each product, a positive whole quantity, and selling or giveaway purpose for each line

questions.explanation: Each reservation must remain attributable to the intended event and product, with an accurate quantity and selling or giveaway classification.

questions.prompt: Does passing Marketing reservation training authorize Marketing to issue stock, process return custody, release quality holds, or approve adjustments?

options.label: Yes, certification unlocks all Warehouse actions
No. It certifies reservation only, and the active Marketing role grant is still required
Only when Marketing created the event

questions.explanation: Training does not grant a role or widen its permissions. Reservation certification cannot authorize issue, return custody, quality release, or approval.

questions.prompt: A multi-product reservation reports one saved line and an unconfirmed response for the remaining lines. What should Marketing do next?

options.label: Immediately submit the whole draft again
Assume nothing was saved and create an identical reservation
Check the recorded allocations and coordinate any uncertainty before creating another reservation

questions.explanation: An uncertain response is not proof that nothing saved. Reconcile confirmed and unconfirmed lines first to avoid duplicate commitments.
